thread:
mike: throwing out a focused proposal: compact 'degrade' events for every fallback (tiny payload) + sampled full traces. but add per-route sampling granularity (so high-volume routes get lower trace rates). want feedback on schema + opt-in exposure.

anya: per-route sampling makes sense. ops currently can't afford full traces for text-embed routes. what's the compact payload?

mike: compact = reason_enum (coarse), route_name, prompt_hash_prefix(8), model_tag, ts, sample_id. no infra ids. example one-liner: {evt:degrade_compact, reason:capacity, route:embeddings-prod, phash:fc3a1b2c, mv:v1.4, id:s-9} (we'll keep that as a string blob).

jord: love the per-route sample rate. suggest config: global_trace_rate=0.002, route_adjustments: embeddings-prod=0.0002, chat-prod=0.005. also emergency_mode multiplier for bursts.

compliance: audit note: regulators may ask for "all fallbacks" in a window. sampling is okay if we provide a deterministic replay path using prompt_hash+seed+model_snapshot and an auditable access flow to raw inputs. confirm retention windows.

mike: plan: compact events retained 90d, raw prompts & seeds retained 30d internal-only. replay workflow requires legal + compliance approval and is logged. compact events expose only hashes publicly.

anya: UX idea for Console: per-route small viz with stacked reasons and a sample-rate control (read-only) for customers. also a one-click "enable debug traces for 24h" button (RBAC gated and logged).

jord: implementational: route-specific kafka topics or a single topic with partitioning by route. add per-customer hard cap of compact events/minute. pseudoconfig: max_compact_per_min=1200, route_sample_overrides in config.

sre-bot: infra note: will add circuit-breaker to producer to backpressure events during incidents and an alert when trace writes hit 80% of budget.

mike: API exposure debate: default keep reason out of responses. provide opt-in header X-RW-Degrade-Reason and require account-level consent toggle in Console. that avoids accidental coupling.

compliance: confirm hashing scheme is collision-resistant enough for replay. also require encryption-at-rest for raw prompts and strict RBAC for replay. I'll put together a checklist.

anya: next steps: jord to draft route-based sampling config + producer changes, mike to write header opt-in spec and consent copy, compliance to draft replay access checklist. sync in 48h?

mike: yep. I'll create ticket INF-1810 and assign. thanks all. :thumbsup:
